tagline: 宾得胶片单反相机，1999 年发布
description: 宾得于1999年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Focal plane shutter with speeds from 30 to 1/2000 sec. B, 2 to 1/2000 sec manual. Flash Sync 1/30 to 1/100。使用35mm film with speeds of 25 to 5000 ISO, with auto DX, 6 to 6400 ISO manual。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm film with speeds of 25 to 5000 ISO, with auto DX, 6 to 6400 ISO manual
specs.快门: Focal plane shutter with speeds from 30 to 1/2000 sec. B, 2 to 1/2000 sec manual. Flash Sync 1/30 to 1/100
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, Guide number 11 - slow synch and automatic daylight synch; discharge level automatically adjusted; redeye reduction mode selectable
specs.英文简介: The MZ-7 (ZX-7 in the USA) is a autofocus 35mm SLR camera from Pentax introduced in 1999 as a succesor of the MZ-5/5n.
